outfit.prose: her signature official Endfield supervisor attire: a loose cropped white techwear jacket with wide sleeves worn over a sleeveless white high-neck tunic dress with a delicate necktie, a technical utility belt, sheer black pantyhose with a yellow thigh strap on the left leg, black high heels, and black combat gloves, wielding a sleek sci-fi protocol dagger
